package com.certificate.backend.service;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.Map;

@Slf4j
@Service
public class IpfsService {

    @Value("${pinata.jwt}")
    private String pinataJwt;                          // Bearer token tá»« Pinata dashboard

    @Value("${pinata.api.url:https://api.pinata.cloud/pinning/pinFileToIPFS}")
    private String pinataUploadUrl;

    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    public IpfsService(RestTemplate restTemplate) {
        this.restTemplate = restTemplate;
    }

    /**
     * Upload 1 file PDF lÃªn IPFS qua Pinata.
     *
     * @param pdfBytes  ná»™i dung file PDF (byte[] tá»« CertificatePdfGenerator)
     * @param certId    mÃ£ vÄƒn báº±ng â€” dÃ¹ng lÃ m tÃªn file trÃªn Pinata (dá»… tra cá»©u)
     * @return          ipfsHash (CID) â€” vd: "QmT5NvUtoM5nWFfrDs..."
     * @throws IpfsUploadException náº¿u upload tháº¥t báº¡i
     */
    public String uploadPdf(byte[] pdfBytes, String certId) {
        log.info("[IPFS] Báº¯t Ä‘áº§u upload PDF cho vÄƒn báº±ng: {}", certId);

        try {
            // BÆ¯á»šC 1: Táº¡o multipart body
            // Pinata nháº­n file qua multipart/form-data vá»›i field name "file"
            MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = buildMultipartBody(pdfBytes, certId);

            // BÆ¯á»šC 2: Táº¡o header vá»›i JWT
            HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders();

            // BÆ¯á»šC 3: Gá»i Pinata API
            HttpEntity<MultiValueMap<String, Object>> requestEntity = new HttpEntity<>(body, headers);

            ResponseEntity<Map> response = restTemplate.exchange(
                    pinataUploadUrl,
                    HttpMethod.POST,
                    requestEntity,
                    Map.class
            );

            // BÆ¯á»šC 4: Láº¥y IpfsHash tá»« response JSON
            // Response máº«u: {"IpfsHash":"QmXyz...","PinSize":12345,"Timestamp":"..."}
            String ipfsHash = extractIpfsHash(response);

            log.info("[IPFS] Upload thÃ nh cÃ´ng. CertId={} | Hash={}", certId, ipfsHash);
            return ipfsHash;

        } catch (IpfsUploadException e) {
            throw e; // re-throw Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ context
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IpfsUploadException(
                    "Upload IPFS tháº¥t báº¡i cho vÄƒn báº±ng: " + certId, e
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Táº¡o multipart body cho Pinata.
     *
     * Pinata yÃªu cáº§u 2 field:
     *   - "file"            : ná»™i dung file nhá»‹ phÃ¢n
     *   - "pinataMetadata"  : JSON string chá»©a tÃªn file (giÃºp tra cá»©u trÃªn dashboard)
     */
    private MultiValueMap<String, Object> buildMultipartBody(byte[] pdfBytes, String certId) {
        MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();

        // Field "file": wrap byte[] thÃ nh Resource Ä‘á»ƒ Spring set Ä‘Ãºng Content-Type
        org.springframework.core.io.ByteArrayResource fileResource =
                new org.springframework.core.io.ByteArrayResource(pdfBytes) {
                    @Override
                    public String getFilename() {
                        // TÃªn file hiá»ƒn thá»‹ trÃªn Pinata dashboard
                        return "CERT-" + certId + ".pdf";
                    }
                };
        body.add("file", fileResource);

        // Field "pinataMetadata": JSON string (Pinata dÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘áº·t tÃªn pin)
        // Format: {"name":"CERT-HUST-2024-001.pdf"}
        String metadata = String.format("{\"name\":\"CERT-%s.pdf\"}", certId);
        body.add("pinataMetadata", metadata);

        return body;
    }

    /**
     * Táº¡o HttpHeaders:
     *   - Authorization: Bearer {JWT}   â† xÃ¡c thá»±c Pinata
     *   - Content-Type: multipart/form-data  â† Spring tá»± set boundary
     */
    private HttpHeaders buildHeaders() {
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA);
        headers.setBearerAuth(pinataJwt);  // "Authorization: Bearer ..."
        return headers;
    }

    /**
     * TrÃ­ch xuáº¥t IpfsHash tá»« response body cá»§a Pinata.
     * Response JSON máº«u:
     * {
     *   "IpfsHash": "QmT5NvUtoM5nWFfrDs...",
     *   "PinSize": 85614,
     *   "Timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"
     * }
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private String extractIpfsHash(ResponseEntity<Map> response) {
        if (response.getStatusCode() != HttpStatus.OK) {
            throw new IpfsUploadException(
                    "Pinata tráº£ vá» HTTP " + response.getStatusCode()
            );
        }

        Map<String, Object> responseBody = response.getBody();
        if (responseBody == null || !responseBody.containsKey("IpfsHash")) {
            throw new IpfsUploadException(
                    "Pinata response khÃ´ng cÃ³ trÆ°á»ng IpfsHash. Body: " + responseBody
            );
        }

        String hash = (String) responseBody.get("IpfsHash");
        if (hash == null || hash.isBlank()) {
            throw new IpfsUploadException("IpfsHash rá»—ng trong response cá»§a Pinata");
        }

        return hash;
    }

    // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    // CUSTOM EXCEPTION
    // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

    public static class IpfsUploadException extends RuntimeException {
        public IpfsUploadException(String message) {
            super(message);
        }
        public IpfsUploadException(String message, Throwable cause) {
            super(message, cause);
        }
    }
}

package com.certificate.backend.service;

import com.google.zxing.BarcodeFormat;
import com.google.zxing.client.j2se.MatrixToImageWriter;
import com.google.zxing.common.BitMatrix;
import com.google.zxing.qrcode.QRCodeWriter;
import com.lowagie.text.pdf.BaseFont;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.thymeleaf.TemplateEngine;
import com.certificate.backend.model.entity.StudentEntity;
import org.thymeleaf.context.Context;
import org.xhtmlrenderer.pdf.ITextRenderer;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Base64;

@Service
public class PdfExportService {

    @Autowired
    private TemplateEngine templateEngine;

    @Autowired
    private TranslationService translationService;

    // TODO: Thay báº±ng link Ngrok thá»±c táº¿ cá»§a báº¡n khi cháº¡y (vÃ­ dá»¥: ngrok http 3000)
    private final String NGROK_BASE_URL = "https://abcd-1234.ngrok-free.app";

    // Truyá»n thÃªm degreeNo vÃ  regNo tá»« hÃ m Cáº¥p Báº±ng vÃ o Ä‘Ã¢y
    public byte[] generatePdfBytes(StudentEntity student, String certId, String regNo) throws Exception {
        Context context = new Context();

        // â”€â”€ 1. THÃ”NG TIN CHUNG VÃ€ MÃƒ XÃC THá»°C â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        context.setVariable("universityEn", translationService.translateSchoolName(student.getSchool().getSchoolName().toUpperCase()) );
        context.setVariable("rectorName", student.getSchool().getRectorName());
        context.setVariable("date", LocalDate.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy")));
        context.setVariable("degreeNo", certId);
        context.setVariable("regNo", regNo);

        // Táº¡o QR Code dáº«n tá»›i link Ngrok
        String verifyUrl = NGROK_BASE_URL + "/verify?degreeNo=" + certId;
        context.setVariable("qrBase64", generateQRCodeBase64(verifyUrl));


        // â”€â”€ 2. Cá»˜T PHáº¢I (TIáº¾NG VIá»†T) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        context.setVariable("universityVi",student.getSchool().getSchoolName().toUpperCase());
        context.setVariable("majorVi", student.getMajor().toUpperCase());
        context.setVariable("fullNameVi", student.getFullName().toUpperCase());
        context.setVariable("dobVi", student.getDob().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy")));
        context.setVariable("gradYear", String.valueOf(LocalDate.now().getYear()));
        context.setVariable("classificationVi", student.getDegreeType()); // Giáº£ sá»­ entity cÃ³ trÆ°á»ng nÃ y
        context.setVariable("modeOfStudyVi", student.getTrainingType());


        // â”€â”€ 3. Cá»˜T TRÃI (TIáº¾NG ANH - Qua TranslationService) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        context.setVariable("universityEn",translationService.translateSchoolName(student.getSchool().getSchoolName().toUpperCase()));
        context.setVariable("majorEn", translationService.translateMajor(student.getMajor().toUpperCase()));
        context.setVariable("fullNameEn", translationService.removeAccents(student.getFullName()).toUpperCase());
        context.setVariable("dobEn", translationService.formatDateToEnglish(student.getDob()));
        context.setVariable("gradYear", String.valueOf(LocalDate.now().getYear()));
        context.setVariable("classificationEn", translationService.translateDegree(student.getDegreeType()));
        context.setVariable("modeOfStudyEn", translationService.translateTrainingType(student.getTrainingType()));


        // â”€â”€ 4. RENDER HTML â†’ PDF Báº°NG FLYING SAUCER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        String htmlContent = templateEngine.process("certificate", context);

        try (ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            ITextRenderer renderer = new ITextRenderer();

            // Náº¡p Ä‘á»§ bá»™ font Times New Roman Ä‘á»ƒ khÃ´ng bá»‹ lá»—i Font tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t
            addFont(renderer, "fonts/times.ttf");
            addFont(renderer, "fonts/timesbd.ttf");
            addFont(renderer, "fonts/timesi.ttf");
            addFont(renderer, "fonts/timesbi.ttf");

            renderer.setDocumentFromString(htmlContent);
            renderer.layout();
            renderer.createPDF(out);

            return out.toByteArray();
        }
    }

    private void addFont(ITextRenderer renderer, String resourcePath) throws Exception {
        String fontUrl = new ClassPathResource(resourcePath).getURL().toString();
        renderer.getFontResolver().addFont(fontUrl, BaseFont.IDENTITY_H, BaseFont.EMBEDDED);
    }

    // HÃ m phá»¥ trá»£ táº¡o QR Code thÃ nh chuá»—i Base64
    private String generateQRCodeBase64(String text) throws Exception {
        QRCodeWriter qrCodeWriter = new QRCodeWriter();
        // KÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c 150x150 lÃ  vá»«a Ä‘áº¹p cho gÃ³c vÄƒn báº±ng
        BitMatrix bitMatrix = qrCodeWriter.encode(text, BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE, 150, 150);
        ByteArrayOutputStream pngOutputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        MatrixToImageWriter.writeToStream(bitMatrix, "PNG", pngOutputStream);
        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(pngOutputStream.toByteArray());
    }
}

package com.certificate.backend.service;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

@Service
public class TranslationService {

    // XÃ³a dáº¥u tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t: Nguyá»…n Äá»©c LuÃ¢n â†’ Nguyen Duc Luan
    public String removeAccents(String str) {
        if (str == null) return "";
        String normalized = Normalizer.normalize(str, Normalizer.Form.NFD);
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("\\p{InCombiningDiacriticalMarks}+");
        return pattern.matcher(normalized)
                .replaceAll("")
                .replace("Ä", "D")
                .replace("Ä‘", "d");
    }

    // Dá»‹ch xáº¿p loáº¡i tá»‘t nghiá»‡p
    public String translateDegree(String degree) {
        if (degree == null) return "";
        return switch (degree.trim().toLowerCase()) {
            case "xuáº¥t sáº¯c"  -> "High Distinction";
            case "giá»i"      -> "Excellent";
            case "khÃ¡"       -> "Good";
            case "trung bÃ¬nh" -> "Average";
            default          -> degree;
        };
    }
    // Dá»‹ch há»‡ Ä‘Ã o táº¡o
    public String translateTrainingType(String type) {
        if (type == null) return "";
        return switch (type.trim().toLowerCase()) {
            case "chÃ­nh quy"         -> "Full-time";
            case "vá»«a lÃ m vá»«a há»c"   -> "Part-time";
            case "tá»« xa"             -> "Distance Learning";
            default                  -> type;
        };
    }

    public String translateMajor(String major) {
        if (major == null) return "";
        return switch (major.trim().toLowerCase()) {
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t cÆ¡ Ä‘iá»‡n tá»­"              -> "Mechatronics Engineering";
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t pháº§n má»m"                -> "Software Engineering";
            case "khoa há»c mÃ¡y tÃ­nh"                -> "Computer Science";
            case "há»‡ thá»‘ng thÃ´ng tin"               -> "Information Systems";
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t mÃ¡y tÃ­nh"                -> "Computer Engineering";
            case "cÃ´ng nghá»‡ thÃ´ng tin"              -> "Information Technology";
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t Ä‘iá»‡n tá»­ - viá»…n thÃ´ng"    -> "Electronics and Telecommunications Engineering";
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t Ä‘iá»u khiá»ƒn vÃ  tá»± Ä‘á»™ng hÃ³a" -> "Control Engineering and Automation";
            case "ká»¹ thuáº­t cÆ¡ khÃ­"                  -> "Mechanical Engineering";
            case "an toÃ n thÃ´ng tin"                -> "Information Security";
            case "quáº£n trá»‹ kinh doanh"              -> "Business Administration";
            default -> removeAccents(major); // Fallback: Náº¿u khÃ´ng cÃ³ trong tá»« Ä‘iá»ƒn thÃ¬ in ra tÃªn tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t khÃ´ng dáº¥u
        };
    }

    public String translateSchoolName(String schoolName) {
        if (schoolName == null) return "";
        return switch (schoolName.trim().toLowerCase()) {
            case "há»c viá»‡n cÃ´ng nghá»‡ bÆ°u chÃ­nh viá»…n thÃ´ng" -> "Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c bÃ¡ch khoa hÃ  ná»™i"                -> "Hanoi University of Science and Technology";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c quá»‘c gia hÃ  ná»™i"                 -> "Vietnam National University, Hanoi";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c kinh táº¿ quá»‘c dÃ¢n"                -> "National Economics University";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c ngoáº¡i thÆ°Æ¡ng"                    -> "Foreign Trade University";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c cÃ´ng nghá»‡ thÃ´ng tin"             -> "University of Information Technology";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c khoa há»c tá»± nhiÃªn"               -> "University of Science";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c sÆ° pháº¡m ká»¹ thuáº­t"                -> "University of Technical Education";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c kiáº¿n trÃºc"                       -> "University of Architecture";
            case "Ä‘áº¡i há»c thÆ°Æ¡ng máº¡i"                      -> "Thuongmai University";
            // ThÃªm cÃ¡c trÆ°á»ng khÃ¡c cá»§a báº¡n vÃ o Ä‘Ã¢y...
            default -> removeAccents(schoolName); // Fallback: Náº¿u khÃ´ng cÃ³ trong tá»« Ä‘iá»ƒn thÃ¬ in ra tÃªn tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t khÃ´ng dáº¥u
        };
    }

    public String formatDateToEnglish(LocalDate date) {
        if (date == null) return "";
        return date.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd MMMM yyyy", Locale.ENGLISH));
    }
}

FILE: D:\Documents\certificate-project\backend\src\main\java\com\certificate\backend\service\VerifyService.java

package com.certificate.backend.service;

import com.certificate.backend.exception.AppException;
import com.certificate.backend.model.dto.Request.SearchRequest;
import com.certificate.backend.model.dto.Response.SearchResponse;
import com.certificate.backend.model.entity.CertificateEntity;
import com.certificate.backend.model.entity.StudentEntity;
import com.certificate.backend.model.enums.ErrorCode;
import com.certificate.backend.repository.CertificateRepository;
import com.certificate.backend.utils.HashUtils;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Map;

@Slf4j
@Service
public class VerifyService {
    @Autowired
    private BlockchainService blockchainService;

    @Autowired
    private CertificateRepository certificateRepository;

    @Value("${pinata.gateway.url}")
    private String ipfsGatewayUrl;


    public SearchResponse search(SearchRequest req){
        CertificateEntity certificate = certificateRepository.findByCertId(req.getCertId())
                .orElseThrow(()-> new AppException(ErrorCode.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND));

        StudentEntity student = certificate.getStudent();
        String inputName = req.getFullName().trim().toLowerCase();
        String dbName = student.getFullName().trim().toLowerCase();

        String dbDob = student.getDob().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy"));

        if (!inputName.equals(dbName) && !req.getDob().equals(dbDob)){
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return searchBlockchain(certificate.getCertId(), student, dbDob);
    }

    public SearchResponse verify(MultipartFile file) {
        try {
            // 1. Láº¥y máº£ng byte tá»« file PDF ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng up lÃªn
            byte[] fileBytes = file.getBytes();

            // 2. TÃNH MÃƒ HASH Báº°NG HÃ€M SHA-256 Cá»¦A Báº N
            String fileHash = HashUtils.computeSha256(fileBytes);

            // 3. TÃ¬m trong Database xem cÃ³ file nÃ o mang mÃ£ Hash nÃ y khÃ´ng
            CertificateEntity certInDb = certificateRepository.findByFileHash(fileHash)
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(ErrorCode.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND,
                            "Cáº¢NH BÃO: File vÄƒn báº±ng nÃ y lÃ  GIáº¢ Máº O hoáº·c ÄÃƒ Bá»Š CHá»ˆNH Sá»¬A!"));

            // 4. Náº¿u tÃ¬m tháº¥y (Hash trÃ¹ng khá»›p 100%), láº¥y certId chá»c lÃªn Blockchain
            return searchBlockchain(certInDb.getCertId(), certInDb.getStudent(),
                    certInDb.getStudent().getDob().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy")));

        } catch (AppException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Lá»—i khi xá»­ lÃ½ file PDF: ", e);
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR, "Lá»—i khÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh khi Ä‘á»c file PDF.");
        }
    }

    // HÃ m phá»¥ trá»£ chá»‘ng lá»—i NullPointerException (NPE)
    private String getSafeString(Map<String, Object> map, String key) {
        Object value = map.get(key);
        return value != null ? value.toString() : ""; // Náº¿u null thÃ¬ tráº£ vá» chuá»—i rá»—ng thay vÃ¬ bÃ¡o lá»—i
    }

    private SearchResponse searchBlockchain(String certId, StudentEntity student, String dobStr){
        var blockchainInfo = blockchainService.getCertificate(certId);

        if (blockchainInfo == null) {
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND, "Báº±ng khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i trÃªn Blockchain!");
        }

        SearchResponse res = new SearchResponse();
        res.setStudentName(getSafeString(blockchainInfo, "studentName"));
        res.setMajor(getSafeString(blockchainInfo, "major"));
        res.setDob(dobStr);
        res.setClassification(getSafeString(blockchainInfo, "degreeType"));

        // KIá»‚M TRA TRáº NG THÃI: TÃ¹y theo key báº¡n lÆ°u á»Ÿ BlockchainService (isRevoked hay isValid)
        boolean isRevoked = (Boolean) blockchainInfo.get("isRevoked");
        res.setStatus(isRevoked ? "REVOKED" : "VALID");
        if(!isRevoked){
            String ipfsHash = getSafeString(blockchainInfo, "ipfsHash");
            String gateway = ipfsGatewayUrl.endsWith("/") ? ipfsGatewayUrl : ipfsGatewayUrl + "/";
            res.setIpfsUrl(gateway + ipfsHash);
        }

        return res;
    }

}



========================================
FILE: D:\Documents\certificate-project\backend\src\main\java\com\certificate\backend\service\WalletService.java
========================================

package com.certificate.backend.service;

import com.certificate.backend.exception.AppException;
import com.certificate.backend.model.enums.ErrorCode;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.web3j.crypto.*;

import javax.crypto.Cipher;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
import java.util.Base64;

@Service
@Slf4j
public class WalletService {

    // AES key 32 kÃ½ tá»± Ä‘á»ƒ mÃ£ hÃ³a private key
    // Äá»c tá»« application.properties - khÃ´ng hardcode
    @Value("${wallet.encryption.key}")
    private String encryptionKey;

    // â”€â”€ Táº¡o vÃ­ má»›i â”€â”€
    public WalletInfo createWallet() {
        try {
            // Táº¡o cáº·p key ngáº«u nhiÃªn
            // ECKeyPair chá»©a: privateKey + publicKey
            ECKeyPair keyPair = Keys.createEcKeyPair();

            // Láº¥y private key dáº¡ng hex string
            // prependHexPrefix thÃªm "0x" vÃ o Ä‘áº§u
            String privateKey = "0x" + keyPair.getPrivateKey().toString(16);

            // TÃ­nh Ä‘á»‹a chá»‰ vÃ­ tá»« public key
            // Keys.getAddress() tá»± tÃ­nh theo chuáº©n Ethereum
            String walletAddress = "0x" + Keys.getAddress(keyPair);

            // MÃ£ hÃ³a private key trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u DB
            String encryptedKey = encryptPrivateKey(privateKey);

            log.info("ÄÃ£ táº¡o vÃ­ má»›i: {}", walletAddress);

            return WalletInfo.builder()
                    .walletAddress(walletAddress)
                    .privateKey(privateKey)
                    .privateKeyEncrypted(encryptedKey)
                    .build();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR);
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ MÃ£ hÃ³a private key báº±ng AES-256 â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    public String encryptPrivateKey(String privateKey) {
        try {
            // Táº¡o key AES tá»« encryptionKey
            SecretKeySpec keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(
                    encryptionKey.getBytes(), "AES"
            );

            // Khá»Ÿi táº¡o Cipher vá»›i thuáº­t toÃ¡n AES
            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES");
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, keySpec);

            // MÃ£ hÃ³a vÃ  encode base64 Ä‘á»ƒ lÆ°u DB dáº¡ng string
            byte[] encrypted = cipher.doFinal(privateKey.getBytes());
            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(encrypted);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR);
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Giáº£i mÃ£ private key khi cáº§n dÃ¹ng â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    public String decryptPrivateKey(String encryptedKey) {
        try {
            SecretKeySpec keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(
                    encryptionKey.getBytes(), "AES"
            );

            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES");
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec);

            // Decode base64 rá»“i giáº£i mÃ£ AES
            byte[] decoded = Base64.getDecoder().decode(encryptedKey);
            return new String(cipher.doFinal(decoded));

        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new AppException(ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR);
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Inner class chá»©a thÃ´ng tin vÃ­ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    @lombok.Data
    @lombok.Builder
    public static class WalletInfo {
        private String walletAddress;
        private String privateKey;              // Chá»‰ dÃ¹ng táº¡m, khÃ´ng lÆ°u
        private String privateKeyEncrypted;     // LÆ°u vÃ o DB
    }
}



========================================
FILE: D:\Documents\certificate-project\backend\src\main\java\com\certificate\backend\utils\HashUtils.java
========================================

package com.certificate.backend.utils;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.HexFormat;

public class HashUtils {
    public static String computeSha256(byte[] data) {
        try {
            MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] hash = digest.digest(data);
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(hash);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ tÃ­nh SHA-256", e);
        }
    }
}
